revise_description: In the stakeholder handoff for this case, the finance partner framed the change in business terms rather than as a spreadsheet checklist. At the latest operating review, the business owner rejected treating this as a cosmetic rerun. The plan has to follow the commercial interpretation below, with the data-pack labels read literally. Finishing QA added a Product Y tier. Up to 60 batches of Product Y fit the ordinary desk; going above 60 batches triggers a one-time 10 GBP QA burden, while the regular and overtime craftsman-hour split remains unchanged. The names shown in backticks are the exact field names used by the data packet and the audit trail.
